scope: Fixed-controller acquisition response diagnostics on the newest one-axis no-drag axial model, for both actuators with and without the 5 mm pad. Finite diagnostics do not qualify chip transfer, calibration, thermal duty, engagement, robot recentering or sanding surface-normal force.
array_retention: No saved arrays or traces. Every executed integration endpoint scored by engine in memory, including loaded-equilibrium startup and acquisition-event subdivisions.
bank_separation: Selected controllers and physical configurations must be frozen by their owner before main execution; no tuning on these diagnostics.
quantization: Change force and acceleration code spacing only: 320 N and 235.3596 m/s2 spans divided by 2^bits. Position/nut encoder resolution stays fixed. Nominal 24-bit code spacing does not imply 24 effective bits or change source noise.
sample_rate: Hold analog noise source and 10 kHz controller fixed. Set shared modeled transport delay to 20 us + 49.6 us*(30000/adc_rate); the 50 us EMA recomputes its per-output-sample coefficient. This is an assumed rate-scaled delay diagnostic, not an exact ADS131M04 SINC3/noise model.
bandwidth: Matched two-pole analog envelope changed jointly on force, acceleration and relative-position channels, with fixed source noise normalized to 3177.13 Hz reference ENBW. Output filtered noise is measured by the engine and need not equal source RMS fields.
acceleration_removal: Engine has no independent reconstruction-only switch. Set acceleration scale, source noise and bias to zero, keeping known gravity tare and identified tool mass. This jointly removes measured inertia reconstruction, measured-acceleration feedforward and integrated velocity estimation.
noise_scope: Latest acceleration source is 0.014 m/s2 at fixed reference ENBW; it does not reproduce the historical ADXL354 source plus separate ADC noise. Analog source noise is kept unchanged in ADC rate/bit comparisons.
calibration_scope: One-at-a-time positive force/acceleration bias and +/-1% identified S mass. Finite sensitivities, not bounds on a joint residual box; true mechanics and loaded equilibrium stay unchanged.
untested: Independent force/acceleration timestamp skew: newest engine has only shared acquisition transport delay.
Independent reconstruction-only removal of acceleration while retaining all other acceleration-based feedback: not available in frozen engine.
Exact converter SINC3 transfer and separate converter output-noise versus sample-rate law.
Load-cell nonlinearity, temperature drift, creep, cross-axis coupling and unknown sanding drag.
failure_accounting: Keep preparation rejection, executed force criterion, physical stops, actuator/sensor range screens and catalogue RMS-current screen separate. Combined eligible pass requires force<=0.5 N, completed, actuator/sensor range screens and RMS-current screen when defined.
pilot: Before main matrix, rerun first frozen soft-pad coil/screw recording from retained evaluation JSON without source mutation. Compare every recorded numerical/boolean metric except wall runtime. This checks runner/engine repeatability, not independent native or hardware qualification.
